mission: Han/Leia Falcon galley conversation — the political disagreement is named but not settled.
why_now: The Centerpoint reactivation is now public.
opening_hook: Han and Leia in the galley with a half-empty caf pot between them.
conflict: Han's argument that Corellia has a legitimate grievance vs. Leia's argument that the grievance does not justify a super-weapon.
turning_point: Leia tells Han she will not ask him to agree with her; Han tells Leia he will not ask her to agree with him.
closing_hook: Both of them finishing the caf pot without refilling it.
sensory_details: Caf bitter and late; galley lighting tuned low; a small mess of data-chips on the table.

stakes.interpersonal: The marriage's register of mutual non-pressure.
stakes.external: The political frame they can no longer share.

notes: Structural preview of the operational separation.
